scope: New player availability, lineup rotation, pitcher/bullpen and player-minutes workload features; actual local research, not another weight-only literature review
two_leg_policy: Two individually eligible legs only, otherwise no bet. No production policy change.

data.primary: PR423 cleaned actual tipster matched rosters and saved model references; genuine tipster/market/fixed9:1 where actually present
data.auxiliary: PR422 large historical_market_proxy prices/outcomes may train/statistically evaluate new feature models, never called existing service or actual tipster model
data.no_substitution: Report primary and auxiliary separately. Missing XI, player workload, source timestamps or join identity never replaced by generic form/rest and called completed new information.

feature_contract: Exact cohort/event_id/league/kickoff; numeric values with per-field max_fact_time, observed_at, source hashes and availability tier. Keep missing distinct from zero.
evidence_views: captured_pregame: actual locally recorded observation and fact time before decision, valid content hash; labels and quote times still audited separately
retrospective_lagged: only facts from prior games, no current-game/final-season leakage, observed-at-after-event never backdated
unverified: reject from model fitting; preserve reason and coverage
prediction_cutoff: Kickoff minus30min; actual matched price validity and receipt unproven cases stay retrospective. Two-leg composition must respect each feature/quote availability, same league/day/issued round and distinct games/teams.
models: actual tipster unique direction using market probability (direction-only reference)
fixed market90 actual-tipster10 reference when actual votes present
fixed actual9:1 anchor90 plus new-feature model10 (explicit three-input blend, not original9:1)
preprocessing: Training-only median/scale, explicit missing indicators, standardize and clip z to5. No fit on validation/test. Complete source/evidence availability required for the declared bundle; report common support and coverage.
temporal_evaluation: 60/20/20 KST unique dates, mandatory50/20/30 sensitivity; splits overlap and are not independent external replications. Keep event identities in one partition; no test outcome selection.
training_minimum: 30 independent training events,10 validation if hyperparameters selected; fixedL2/weights require no posthoc validation selection. Require at least10 heldout events to compare, else insufficient. Auxiliary past-only training may be used for primary matched evaluation with exact physical-event dedup and cutoff before primary validation/test.
label_availability: Use actual first result receipt where available. Otherwise a48h kickoff embargo is explicitly an assumption and cannot certify strict as-of training.
ticket_threshold: Each model p>=0.55 and p*odds>1; no upper odds cap; no valid second leg =>no ticket
payout: Original single odds; parlay product floor2dec then ceil1dec; void leg1.00/allvoid refund; actual labels only
forward_development: Implement/test local capture journal and provider adapters to record future source/label observations honestly. No cron activation, deployment, production file writes or paid purchases.
adoption: Research PR preserves code/evidence only. Already exposed archives, sparse primary cohorts or auxiliary proxy improvements are not sufficient for production replacement or future-profit claim.
